reuse.why: Builds the new rule on the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and RecurConfig type, and replaces every caller's inline skipWeekend ternary with one shared applyWeekendRule.

duplication.why: The three previously copied weekend ternaries collapse into one helper; only schedule-template calls applyWeekendRule twice per date via two near-identical closures.

placement.why: The weekend rule and lookahead constant live in shared/schedules.ts beside getNextDate and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, and rule-utils just carries frequency in the rschedule data.

scope.why: Focused on the rule, with a small incidental rename of the rschedule data key weekendSolve to weekendSolveMode to fit the RecurConfig shape.

maintainability.why: One function decides whether and how to move or skip a weekend date for all paths; the lookahead-multiplier and the double evaluation in schedule-template are slightly awkward.

disguised_duplication.where: getOccurrenceDate and isSkippedOccurrence in schedule-template.ts both call applyWeekendRule on the same date, an obvious redundancy rather than a disguised copy

one_place.where: applyWeekendRule in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by getNextDate, schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and budget/schedule-template.ts
